newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Thieves take $427,000 from S.African police safe.
newsitem.headline: Thieves take $427,000 from S.African police safe.

text.p: About two million rand ($427,000) in local and foreign currency was stolen last weekend from a safe in a police station at Johannesburg international airport, South African police said in a statement on Friday.
"One of the many questions that needs to be answered satisfactorily is why the key to the safe was, contrary to standing instructions, left in a drawer," the statement said.
